notes: The ASV renders `אֶל הֲמִיתוֹ` nominally, so the infinitive takes *destruction* and its suffix the possessive under rule 18; the Hebrew gloss *causing him to die* was read and set aside under rule 38.
The positive existential `יֵשׁ` takes the presentative frame, headed on the finite word rather than on the supplied *there*, as rule 50 heads an existential on the word carrying its own sense.
